# hermes-otel-plugin

> OpenTelemetry (OTLP) observability plugin for the NousResearch Hermes agent.
> Exports each Hermes turn as GenAI-convention spans (invoke_agent → chat /
> execute_tool, with real measured durations, tokens, cost, TTFT) plus
> dashboard-shaped OTLP log records (user_prompt / session_start /
> api_response / tool_result). Works with any OTLP backend: OpenTelemetry
> Collector, Jaeger, Grafana Tempo, Honeycomb. Fail-open: without the OTel SDK
> every hook no-ops. Content capture (prompts/responses/tool I/O) is opt-in via
> HERMES_OTEL_CAPTURE_CONTENT, off by default.

Install from the Hermes catalog after approval: `hermes plugins install traceverse-hermes-otel`, then `hermes plugins enable traceverse_hermes_otel`. Before approval, install directly with `hermes plugins install Mandark-droid/hermes-otel-plugin`. The only hard runtime dependency is
`pip install opentelemetry-sdk opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http`.
Default endpoint http://localhost:4318 (override: HERMES_OTEL_ENDPOINT).
Set HERMES_OTEL_LOGS_ENABLED=false to skip the dashboard log pipeline entirely
(spans-only OTLP receivers without /v1/logs); spans are unaffected.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Mandark-droid/hermes-otel-plugin/blob/main/README.md): install paths, quickstart, config env vars, span model, AI-agent contract block
- [ADVANCED](https://github.com/Mandark-droid/hermes-otel-plugin/blob/main/ADVANCED.md): genai-otel-instrument extras — GPU/energy/CO2 metrics + inline eval suite (PII, toxicity, bias, prompt-injection, hallucination)

## Source (docstrings are the authoritative reference)

- [__init__.py](https://github.com/Mandark-droid/hermes-otel-plugin/blob/main/__init__.py): register(ctx) + Hermes lifecycle hooks (the only Hermes-coupled module)
- [emitter.py](https://github.com/Mandark-droid/hermes-otel-plugin/blob/main/emitter.py): GenAI span model — invoke_agent / chat / execute_tool attributes, duration backdating
- [log_emitter.py](https://github.com/Mandark-droid/hermes-otel-plugin/blob/main/log_emitter.py): dashboard log-record field contract
- [cost.py](https://github.com/Mandark-droid/hermes-otel-plugin/blob/main/cost.py): local-model cost estimation (model size → price tier)
- [provider.py](https://github.com/Mandark-droid/hermes-otel-plugin/blob/main/provider.py): tracer/logger bootstrap (genai_otel preferred, plain OTel SDK fallback)
